versions.changelog: Add Git extension to VSCode Web

Initial release of the devboxes skill: manage development containers with integrated VSCode, VNC, and Traefik app routing.

- Provides sandboxed dev environments as containers with self-assigned IDs, VSCode Web, noVNC, and pre-routed service URLs.
- Automated onboarding guide: detects required paths, sets up Docker/Traefik/network, generates an ID counter, and patches OpenClaw config.
- All environment URLs/variables (`VSCODE_URL`, `NOVNC_URL`, `APP_URL_*`, etc.) are auto-generated and shared within each devbox.
- Supports browser automation via Chrome DevTools Protocol.
- Lifecycle and routing are fully managed by OpenClaw; no manual container or Traefik config necessary.
- Includes complete instructions for onboarding, spawning devboxes, and reporting status.
